text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Against all odds, the one who conquered 
the Takarazuka Kinen was— Meisho Doto! 
Though she flinched at her own victory, 
her strength was undeniable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, following this result, Narita 
Top Road and Admire Vega found firm hope, 
believing they too could surely defeat the 
Overlord.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O is shaken by a presence that 
threatens her. Seeing her this way, Meisho 
Doto puts a certain idea into action—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, having carved out her own future, 
Narita Top Road advances to the first race 
of the Autumn GⅠ campaign—the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!
